# infrawrench_event_subscription (Resource)

An event subscription: Infrawrench's own events (cost anomalies, budget thresholds, critical and high posture findings, drift, declared incidents, just-in-time access, SLO burn, metric alerts, account sync failures) delivered as JSON to a signed HTTPS webhook, or published to an AWS EventBridge rule's bus or a GCP Pub/Sub topic in a connected account.

Set exactly one destination: `webhook_url`, or all three `publish_*` attributes. Switching between the two replaces the subscription.

**The webhook signing secret lands in your Terraform state.** The API returns it once, at creation and on a reroll, and `signing_secret` keeps it so your receiver's configuration can reference it. Treat state accordingly. Bump `secret_version` to reroll: the previous secret keeps signing for 24 hours.

A subscription that keeps failing for three days is turned off by the server (see `disabled_reason`); the next apply with `enabled = true` turns it back on and clears its failure history.

Receiving cost events (or every event, when `event_types` is empty) needs `costs:read` as well as `org:settings:write`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every critical incident and posture finding, signed, to your own receiver.
resource "infrawrench_event_subscription" "security_feed" {
  name         = "Security feed"
  webhook_url  = "https://hooks.example.com/infrawrench"
  event_types  = ["posture.finding.detected", "incident.declared", "incident.resolved"]
  min_severity = "warning"

  # Bump to reroll; the previous secret keeps signing for 24 hours.
  secret_version = 1
}

# Hand the secret to whatever verifies the signature.
output "security_feed_secret" {
  value     = infrawrench_event_subscription.security_feed.signing_secret
  sensitive = true
}

# Production cost and drift events onto an EventBridge rule's bus.
resource "infrawrench_event_subscription" "prod_bus" {
  name                     = "Prod event bus"
  publish_account_id       = "acc_0a1b2c3d"
  publish_resource_type_id = "eventbridge-rule"
  publish_resource_id      = "res_4e5f6a7b"
  event_types              = ["cost.anomaly.detected", "budget.threshold.crossed", "drift.detected"]
  environments             = ["prod"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name, 1 to 120 characters.

### Optional

- `account_ids` (Set of String) Only events about these accounts. An event about no single account (a drift window spanning several, a declared incident) never matches a non-empty set. At most 100.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether events are delivered. Defaults to `true`.
- `environments` (Set of String) Only events whose resource carries one of these values in an `env`, `environment` or `stage` tag (case-insensitive). An event with no environment never matches a non-empty set. At most 100.
- `event_types` (Set of String) Event types to receive, e.g. `cost.anomaly.detected`, `incident.declared`. Omit or leave empty for every event, including types added later. At most 100.
- `min_severity` (String) Lowest severity delivered: `info`, `warning` or `critical`. Omit for all.
- `publish_account_id` (String) The connected account to publish through (see the `infrawrench_accounts` data source).
- `publish_resource_id` (String) The destination resource's Infrawrench id (see the `infrawrench_resources` data source).
- `publish_resource_type_id` (String) The destination's resource type: `eventbridge-rule` (AWS; events go to the rule's bus with source `infrawrench` and the event type as `detail-type`) or `pubsub-topic` (GCP; messages carry `eventType`, `eventVersion` and `eventId` attributes).
- `secret_version` (Number) Change this to any other number to reroll the webhook signing secret. Has no other meaning.
- `webhook_url` (String) An `https` URL that receives each event as a signed POST. Redirects are not followed, and hosts in private or internal address space are refused.

### Read-Only

- `destination_label` (String) Human label for the destination, as the settings page shows it.
- `disabled_reason` (String) Why the server turned the subscription off, when it did.
- `id` (String) Infrawrench's id for this subscription. `terraform import` works, but the signing secret is not recoverable; bump `secret_version` after importing to get one.
- `secret_hint` (String) Last four characters of the current signing secret.
- `signing_secret` (String, Sensitive) The webhook signing secret (`iwhsec_…`), for verifying the `Infrawrench-Signature` header. Null for publish destinations and after an import.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The id is in the URL when you open the object in the app, and in the
# --json output of the Infrawrench CLI (`infrawrench webhooks --json`).
terraform import infrawrench_event_subscription.example 0a1b2c3d-4e5f-6a7b-8c9d-0e1f2a3b4c5d
```
